'''XV-344H''' was a [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]] located somewhere in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. When the [[Ardan resistance]] had to catch a [[Var Narek|traitor]], a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump landed them very close to XV-344H.<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I" />
